lblLine: Change Area: choose what each of the four HSD lines becomes, then Apply.
lblLine1: Line 1 (points 31-36): pick in the box beside it what it becomes.
lblLine2: Line 2 (points 37-42): pick in the box beside it what it becomes.
lblLine3: Line 3 (points 43-48): pick in the box beside it what it becomes.
lblLine4: Line 4 (points 49-54): pick in the box beside it what it becomes.
btnCancel: Closes the window; the four lines stay as they are.
btnApply: Apply: sets the four lines as chosen, asking first before it replaces a line that holds other points. Counts in Save to DTC.
cboArea1: What line 1 becomes: (as it is) keeps it, No Line clears it, or a track the mission knows (tanker, AWACS, JSTARS, CAP, part of your route) lays its six points along it.
cboArea2: What line 2 becomes: (as it is) keeps it, No Line clears it, or a track the mission knows (tanker, AWACS, JSTARS, CAP, part of your route) lays its six points along it.
cboArea3: What line 3 becomes: (as it is) keeps it, No Line clears it, or a track the mission knows (tanker, AWACS, JSTARS, CAP, part of your route) lays its six points along it.
cboArea4: What line 4 becomes: (as it is) keeps it, No Line clears it, or a track the mission knows (tanker, AWACS, JSTARS, CAP, part of your route) lays its six points along it.
btnClearLine1: Clear Line: sets line 1 to No Line, so Apply clears it.
btnClearLine2: Clear Line: sets line 2 to No Line, so Apply clears it.
btnClearLine3: Clear Line: sets line 3 to No Line, so Apply clears it.
btnClearLine4: Clear Line: sets line 4 to No Line, so Apply clears it.
